title: (Pwn2Own) Synology RT6600ax Improper Access Control Firewall Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass firewall rules and access the LAN interface on affected installations of Synology RT6600ax routers. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of firewall rules. The issue results from improper access control after the initial setup. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of root.
